content:
alex: Quick one — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/421 is ready but blocked by CODEOWNERS. It touches infra/k8s/ and runtime/model-serving. CI green. Who has sign-off here? Need to merge for hotfix.
ci-bot: Merge blocked by CODEOWNERS: approvals required from @eng-runtime/core-team and @eng-platform/infra.
sam: Looks like CODEOWNERS patterns are: `/runtime/* -> @eng-runtime/core-team` and `/infra/k8s/* -> @eng-platform/infra`. Both dirs changed?
giri: If the runtime change is non-functional, platform can probably approve infra. But runtime lib bump should get at least one runtime reviewer ack.
alex: It's a very small change: adjust `livenessProbe` timeout for GPU pods (`infra/k8s/deploy.yaml`) and bump logging lib minor in `runtime/pkg/logging` (`1.2.3 -> 1.2.4`). No API changes.
maria: Is this blocking production? If it's a hotfix we can follow expedited flow — platform-oncall can approve infra side and runtime lead can sign off quickly.
platform-oncall: I can take a look now. Please paste the diff or the relevant snippet.
alex: Paste:```yaml
# infra/k8s/deploy.yaml
containers:
  - name: runtime
    livenessProbe:
      failureThreshold: 3
      periodSeconds: 10
      timeoutSeconds: 5  # bumped from 2 to 5 for GPU cold-starts
```
Runtime bump: `runtime/pkg/logging` bump from `1.2.3` -> `1.2.4` (minor bugfix in formatting).
sam: k8s diff looks fine to me at a glance. Who owns the logging lib? giri? if it's just formatting bug, i'm comfortable, but want runtime owner to ack.
giri: I maintain that logging package. I wasn't auto-requested because CODEOWNERS doesn't have the fine-grained pattern. If you add me as reviewer i'll do a quick look. Also recommend we add `/runtime/pkg/logging/* @eng-runtime/logging` to CODEOWNERS to avoid this.
alex: Adding label `urgent-approval` and adding @giri as reviewer now. Question: can platform-oncall approve infra and we merge with a runtime +1 in-thread (expedite), then runtime formal review can follow post-merge if anything pops?
maria: We don't typically merge without CODEOWNERS approvals, but for hotfixes there's an owner-emergency process: add `emergency` label + one lead sign-off. So platform + runtime lead explicit +1 in thread should be fine. Make sure to note in PR why.
sam: I'll do the runtime lead +1 after reading the diffs. Ping me when giri posts review.
platform-oncall: Reviewed infra change — benign change, no rollout risk. +1 from infra. :white_check_mark:
giri: Checked the logging bump, it's safe (formatting fix only). Left a quick inline comment but no blocking issues. +1.
ci-bot: All checks passing. Merging queued. Post-merge: CI will run full integration tests. Note: CODEOWNERS approvals recorded in PR history.
alex: Merging now, thanks everyone :rocket:
